selection: Original baseline plus two literal sequential labels, declared before execution; never replace failures.
rewardPolicy: Collect native gold. Skip card, or take native offered card index 0. Skip other pending rewards.
combatPolicy: First battle: bounded Evaluate route. Second: defend/draw until acquired ManaShield is naturally playable, then bounded Evaluate routes. Unsupported acquired cards stop explicitly.
repeatPolicy: Freeze the first execution's emitted first-battle route and second-battle chunks when present; second execution replays those actions. No seed replacement or victory filtering.
